task_context.problem_statement:
Solve
\[\frac{1}{x - 5} > 0.\]Enter your answer using interval notation.
task_context.reference_solution: If $x < 5,$ then $\frac{1}{x - 5} < 0,$ and if $x > 5,$ then $\frac{1}{x - 5} > 0,$ so the solution is $x \in \boxed{(5,\infty)}.$
